name: Animal Totem Headdress
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 12th; Slot: head; Price: 9,000 gp; Weight: 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This headdress is made from the head and/or pelt of a wolf, bear, buffalo, lion or other great cat, giant eagle or giant snake. The headdress counts as a light helm and provides a +1 deflection bonus to the wearer’s AC and a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks.

The headdress also confers the following bonuses based on its type:

Bear: +1 Strength or Constitution
Buffalo: +1 Constitution or Wisdom
Wolf: +1 Dexterity or Constitution
Lion (or other great cat): +1 Strength or Dexterity
Giant eagle: +1 Charisma or Dexterity
Giant snake: +1 Dexterity or Wisdom

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells bull’s strength, bear’s endurance, cat’s grace, eagle’s splendor, shield of faith; Cost: 4,500 gp
